Body.Content: HPC Pack 2012 R2 Update 2 is now available. With this update, HPC Pack supports Linux virtual machines running on Azure. Customers running high-performance computing clusters on Linux can now use the management, deployment, and scheduling capabilities in HPC Pack. For more information about this update, please visit the Microsoft HPC Pack 2012 R2 and HPC Pack 2012 page.
Body.Markdown:
HPC Pack 2012 R2 Update 2 is now available. With this update, HPC Pack supports Linux virtual machines running on Azure. Customers running high-performance computing clusters on Linux can now use the management, deployment, and scheduling capabilities in HPC Pack.

For more information about this update, please visit the Microsoft HPC Pack 2012 R2 and HPC Pack 2012 page.
